name: bambara-mt-benchmark
description: A machine-translation benchmark focused on Bambara (a low-resource Mande language), providing parallel data and evaluation splits to assess translation quality between Bambara and major languages (e.g., English/French). It is intended to measure MT performance in a low-resource multilingual setting and to support research on improving Bambara translation models.
evaluation_method: BLEU (commonly reported; chrF often used as complementary)
reputation: Niche benchmark used in low-resource MT research on Bambara with limited but growing community adoption.
